FAQ

Simple answers.
No fine-print energy.

What types of spaces do you clean?

Homes, apartments, condos, offices, common areas, short-term rentals and post-construction spaces.

Can I request recurring cleaning?

Yes. Weekly, biweekly and monthly schedules can be requested through the quote form.

Do you offer move-in and move-out cleaning?

Yes. We can quote empty-home cleaning for tenants, owners, property managers and new residents.

How do I get pricing?

Use the quote form with your property details, or call us directly at 954-379-6765. We’ll review the scope and provide pricing before booking.
